uploadReceipt.dropzoneText: Drag and drop a receipt image, or
uploadReceipt.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Up to 10 MB.
uploadReceipt.extractionFailedBody: We could not read this receipt automatically. You can still enter the details manually below — the image has already been saved.
uploadReceipt.insufficientExtractionBody: This receipt's photo didn't have enough readable detail to fill in the form automatically. You can still enter the details manually below — the image has already been saved.
uploadReceipt.autoMatchedTitle: This receipt was automatically attached to an existing transaction
uploadReceipt.autoMatchedBody: We found a high-confidence matching transaction and attached the receipt to it — no further action needed.
uploadReceipt.suggestedMatchTitle: We found a transaction that might match this receipt
uploadReceipt.qualityScoreExplanation: A completeness/quality heuristic based on how many fields were found and how many caveats were raised — not a calibrated probability that the values are correct.
uploadReceipt.successMessage: Expense saved. Redirecting to your expenses…
